title: Songwriters' Retreat: 4BR, Rooftop Sauna & Bar
description:
Four levels, four bedrooms, four and a half baths - plus a private rooftop lounge with an infrared sauna, wet bar, Peloton and karaoke. Sleeps 12: a King, two Queens, and Queen-over-Queen built-in bunks, 2 Singles each with an ensuite bath and Smart TV. The main level is pure Nashville: a Bluebird Cafe mural, neon music-venue signs, a gas fireplace, and a songwriting desk with a vintage typewriter. Gourmet kitchen, coffee bar, washer/dryer, free parking, gated complex. Minutes from downtown.
